as_told.title: Vallee finds the Pentacle memo in Blue Book files
as_told.place_text: Project Blue Book files; Battelle Memorial Institute

plain: The scientist and UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have found a classified letter showing that a private research contractor, Battelle, was quietly running a second UFO study alongside Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. The story goes that Vallée came across it while going through Blue Book files kept by the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, who advised the Air Force study. A UFO investigator named James Fox tells it as he has heard it: Vallée "came upon a file" that "was classified that he shouldn't have seen", a letter signed by a Battelle man named Howard C. Cross. Fox credits the documentary The Phenomenon. Michels tells it several times himself and calls the paper the Pentacle memo. In one version he dates it to 1953 and ties it to the report of the Robertson panel, a government panel on UFOs. In another he says Battelle "was behind the scenes" from the start of Blue Book, and draws a line to modern Pentagon officials such as Sean Kirkpatrick and Ronald Moultrie. To those who tell it, the letter suggests the public study was not where the real work was done.
